answer: One concrete defense is bonded enclave identity. Every agent stakes collateral and registers a hardware-rooted attestation key, so minting extra personas requires extra physical enclaves rather than new strings; attacker cost scales linearly with each fake identity. Peers grade a random sample of work, and a bridge contract slashes the bond when two attestations submit near-duplicate output. Honest agents approach their earnings zenith only through sustained distinct contributions, while a clone farm meets a cost ridge it cannot profitably climb.
